notes:
Stop a whole group of bots at once. Each group heading in the Bots list now has a Stop button, showing how many accounts under it are still running. It stops those and leaves everything else alone. If any of them have Keep Bot Running switched on, OPTiC tells you before it stops them, because Auto Launch will bring those back after about fifteen seconds.
Group names with an apostrophe in them. A group whose name contained an apostrophe could not be collapsed, dragged or reordered, and nothing said why. Those headings work like any other now.
